download.title: Download Setting / Cache Management
download.workers: Number of Workers for Concurrent Download
download.workersHelp: Controls how many downloads run in parallel.
download.timeoutHelp: Maximum time to wait for each download before failing.
download.retryAttemptsHelp: Number of retries per failed download request.
download.retryDelayHelp: Wait time between retry attempts when a download fails.

simplify1.title: Primary Simplification (Max Zoom Based)
simplify1.description: Reduces excessive geometry while preserving detail needed for the maximum zoom.

simplify2.title: Tile Preprocessing (Quantization & Boundary Alignment)
simplify2.description: Applies quantization and boundary alignment before tile generation to stabilize workload.

filter.title: Extraction Setting
filter.workersStage1Help: Parallel workers for feature simplification in stage 1.
filter.workersStage2: Number of Workers for Tile Generation (Stage 2)
filter.workersStage2Help: Parallel workers for tile preparation in stage 2.
filter.methodHelp: Selects how small features are filtered before primary simplification.
filter.minimumAreaHelp: Filters out features smaller than this area during the simplify stage.
filter.toleranceHelp: Applies minimal simplification while preserving detail needed at the maximum zoom.
filter.toleranceHelpStage2: Applies secondary simplification for tile preprocessing.
filter.minVertexCountHelp: Only apply area filtering when feature vertices exceed this count.
filter.quickRejectHelp: Lower values reject more tiny features quickly.
filter.simpleShapeVertexHelp: Vertex count threshold for simple-shape handling.
filter.elongatedShapeHelp: Correction factor for elongated simple shapes.
filter.quantizeHelp: Coordinate quantization used in tile preprocessing to reduce size and stabilize boundaries.
filter.quantizeStarHelp: ★1 is the coarsest rounding (lowest precision); higher stars increase precision.

tile.title: Tile Generation (Zoom-Aware Final Simplification)
tile.description: Performs final zoom-aware simplification and generates vector tiles.
tile.bufferSizeHelp: Extra margin to avoid visible seams at tile edges.
tile.maxZoomHelp: Highest zoom level to generate tiles for.
tile.tileCountThresholdHelp: Stops tile generation once the tile count exceeds this value.
tile.zoomLevelsHelp: Zoom levels to generate tiles for.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Visualize generated vector tiles on the map.
preview.noTiles: No vector tiles are available yet. Run the build to generate tiles.
preview.waiting: Vector tiles are being prepared. The map will appear once tiles are ready.
